notes: Only a unique configured endpoint with verified hardware and a matching healthy deployed model appears. Duplicate endpoint aliases never add physical capacity.

Resources verified by read-only saved SDL for existing deployment 1792883508772 on 2026-10-25: 4 vCPU,16 GiB RAM,100 GiB storage. Provider record advertises city=LIS,country=PT,location-region=eu-southwest. Environment overrides support future relocation.

rentalUsdPerHour comes from the configured per-lease cost plus margin. rental records its own source, policy timestamp and price basis. The GPU Economy median is a separate comparison. Null means unavailable, never free.
economy, awsSpot and awsOnDemand, when present, have {usdPerHour,updatedAt,source,sourceUrl}; AWS values also have region and instanceType.
AWS comparisons accept live collector records only, not fixtures or static defaults.
No 24-hour price change is returned until a real observation exists near 24 hours ago.
Node counts are physical endpoints. Missing fleet data returns null counts. Utilization is sampled worker occupancy, not invented device telemetry.
Poll every 5 seconds. No history is backfilled.
A configured rental policy remains active until changed; no external market-feed expiry is invented for it. AWS comparison discounts require fresh same-card spot and on-demand observations.

Additional GPUs require GPU_X_CARD, VRAM_GB, VCPU, RAM_GB, STORAGE_GB and MODEL_ID plus a healthy distinct VLLM_URL. Prices additionally require GPU_X_LEASE_USD_PER_HOUR and GPU_X_PRICE_UPDATED_AT. GPU_X_WIRE_MODEL configures a private wire alias.
